- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
Line or code reference: recover_stalled_issue 14123-14131; standalone stall loop 13107-13116; _linked_pr_is_merge_queued 12357-12369
Problem: The new ai:done merge-train skip runs before _check_merged_pr_guard and treats any linked PR that still carries ai:merge-queued as an intentional wait. GitHub keeps PR labels after merge. _linked_pr_is_merge_queued only inspects labels; it does not require state OPEN or merged != true. A queued PR that lands (human Merge, leftover auto-merge) therefore never reaches _reconcile_merged_pr_issue.
Why it fails at runtime: The issue stays in ai:done. close_merged_issues_sweep only closes ai:merged / ai:ready-to-merge, and orchestrator-managed children are skipped by issue_pr_status.yml, so the poller's merged-PR stall guard is the healing path. That path is now unreachable, stall_recovery_count does not move, and the wave never reconciles to merged.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
